Hi all,

Thanks for sending, Liam. A couple of items from Finance to finalize before we enable payments:
- We can accept the bank-letter in lieu of micro-deposits if it is on bank letterhead and includes the full account and routing numbers (not masked). The attached template (bank_letter_template.pdf) is what we ask external banks to use; if your bank can provide that it speeds verification.
- Please confirm Fed Tax ID (EIN) to match the W-9 record.
- For remittance: Redwood's payops system prefers a two-line remittance header: first line "PO: <PO_NUMBER>", second line "Invoice: <INVOICE_NUMBER> / VendorRef: <VENDOR_REF>". If Acorn can put PO on the first line exactly as above we should be able to auto-apply.
- ACH vs Wire: ACH preferred for recurring invoices. For one-off urgent payments we can process wires (wire fee policy included below).

Action items for Acorn: please reply with the full account number in the bank letter and confirm EIN.

Ben — once they send the signed bank letter we can onboard; I'll coordinate micro-deposit only if letter doesn't include full numbers. Expect ~2 business days to verify after receiving final docs.
